files.name: CHANGELOG.md
files.body:
### Changed
- **Visual refresh for the main duplicate details view and single top-right Bulk Delete button** ([#206](https://github.com/eldertek/duplicatefinder/issues/206)). Modernized the right-hand duplicate details panel with a structured group header and status badge, an elevated summary toolbar with icon action buttons (`Select All`, `Delete Selected`, `Acknowledge`/`Unacknowledge`, `Preview`, and `Copy File Hash`), a unified file table card with column headers (`Preview`, `Name & Path`, `Size`, `Status`, `Actions`), per-file size and `Original`/`Duplicate`/`Protected` status badges, and compact square icon buttons for `Open Folder`, `Open File`, `Keep Folder`, and `Delete` compatible with both light and dark Nextcloud themes; removed the redundant second `Bulk Delete` button from the left sidebar so `Bulk Delete` lives in a single clear location in the top-right header bar next to `Scan`
